final_message:
`wolfi` and `chainguard` no longer crash on ids like `GO-2026-5932`. For those ids, `SecDBParser.build_reference_links` now returns just the distro security page link, `f"{parser.security_reference_url}/GO-2026-5932"`. CVE and GHSA ids keep their current links.

The cause was that `vulnerability.build_reference_links` returns `None` for ids without a `CVE-` or `GHSA-` prefix, and the parser passed that straight to `urls.extend`. I added a `None` check in `src/vunnel/providers/wolfi/parser.py`, the same way `minimos` already does it.

I ran the wolfi and chainguard unit tests with `PYTHONPATH=src`, and all 16 pass. I didn't add a test for the `GO-` case, and I didn't call `build_reference_links("GO-2026-5932")` directly. The full suite didn't run: plain `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vunnel'`, so `vunnel` doesn't seem to be installed in `.venv`.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root with the one-sentence summary.

steps.command: cd src/vunnel; sed -n 55,80p providers/wolfi/parser.py; sed -n 60,75p providers/secureos/parser.py; grep -n "def build_reference_links" -A25 utils/vulnerability.py; grep -rn "SecDBParser" --include=*.py . | head

cd /tmp/bsvc-ogds5e1v/vunnel; grep -n "^class\|^import\|^from" src/vunnel/providers/wolfi/parser.py | head -30
python - <<'E'
p='src/vunnel/providers/wolfi/parser.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("        urls.extend(vulnerability.build_reference_links(vulnerability_id))\n        return urls","        links = vulnerability.build_reference_links(vulnerability_id)\n        if links:\n            urls.extend(links)\n        return urls",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
git diff --stat
echo '{"summary": "SecDBParser.build_reference_links now tolerates ids without CVE-/GHSA- prefix, falling back to just the distro security page URL."}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/providers/wolfi tests/unit/providers/chainguard 2>&1 | tail -3; PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/providers/wolfi tests/unit/providers/chainguard 2>&1 | tail -3
